newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buyers sidelined by U.S. futures.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buyers sidelined by U.S. futures.

text.p: Rising New York futures prices sent spinners back to the sidelines on Tuesday, industry sources reported.
German and Czech buyers featured strongly in reports of buying interest and a few Italian mills sought Central Asian origins for nearby delivery, they said.
Portuguese sources said some genuine bids were seen but at prices that the trade generally considered to be too low. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
